# Standard GitHub Issue & PR Labels

| Name | Color | Description |
| ---- | ----- | ----------- |
| `bug` | `#d73a4a` | Something isn't working as expected. |
| `enhancement` | `#a2eeef` | New feature or performance request. |
| `documentation` | `#0075ca` | Improvements or additions to documentation. |
| `security` | `#b60205` | Security vulnerabilities or patch updates. |
| `ats-engine` | `#0ea5e9` | Relates to backend ATS scoring algorithms or document parsing. |
| `ai-rewriter` | `#8b5cf6` | Relates to AI STAR bullet rewriter or summary tools. |
| `frontend` | `#1d76db` | Relates to Next.js dashboard UI, React components, or CSS. |
| `good first issue` | `#7057ff` | Good for newcomers to get started. |
| `help wanted` | `#008672` | Extra attention or community assistance needed. |
